_comment: OVERRIDES ONLY. The Independent ('idle single mode') protocol is built in;
see aic/independent.py. This file exists so a server-side change can be
absorbed without editing code. Every key here is optional.
endpoints  name -> full path, replacing the default.
payloads   name -> object merged into that endpoint's request body.
The training schedule is NOT set here - by default it is read live from
pre_start (the account's last-used policy + its saved race agendas).
To override it, pass a JSON file to --schedule with any of:
Fields you omit keep their live default.
